Welcome

Your Oak Hill chiropractor

Chiropractic care is the practice of using spinal alignment to help with a wide range of physical issues, including muscle strain, neck pain and chronic back pain. It is a non-invasive approach to pain relief.

At Precision Chiropractic ATX our team will meet with you to talk through your needs, then build a plan that is right for you.

Meet the doctor

Jon Eberle, DC

Chiropractic BioPhysics

Dr. Jon Eberle is an outdoor sports enthusiast and former multi-sport collegiate athlete. His love for movement and helping others led him to pursue a profession that helps others perform at their best. He knows that performing at your best in all that you do starts with a healthy nervous system. He is an advocate of addressing both structure and function together in order to achieve faster and long-term results. While not working with patients or diving into research, Dr. Eberle enjoys outdoor sports such as mountain biking, snowboarding, and dirt biking.

Dr. Eberle is a CBP-Trained Doctor of Chiropractic. The Techniques of Chiropractic BioPhysics® have been proven in practice for over 30 years.

Meet our team

Chris Hagen, DC

Chiropractic Biophysics

Dr. Chris Hagen is a fourth generation chiropractor, husband and father, basketball coach, dog lover, and lifelong learner. He graduated from Baylor University in Waco, TX and Parker College of Chiropractic in Dallas, TX. He has practiced in South Dakota with his family since graduating, and has since earned his advanced certification in the most researched technique in our profession, Chiropractic BioPhysics (CBP).

Peter Lenhart

Director of Rehab

Peter Lenhart is a native of Dripping Springs and graduate of Southern Methodist University where he studied Applied Physiology and Chemistry. He now serves as the Chiropractic BioPhysics Director of Rehab at Precision Chiropractic. His role is to help patients improve their structure and function via specialized exercises and angular tractions.

Valor Eberle

Chief Joy Officer

Valor has been present at Precision Chiropractic since he was born. As Chief Joy Officer, he will likely recruit you to play with a toy, throw a ball to you, or randomly play a prank on you.

FAQ

Questions people ask

Where is Precision Chiropractic ATX?

We are at 13062 US-290 #100, Austin, TX 78737, on US-290 in Oak Hill. We see people from Oak Hill, Dripping Springs and the wider southwest Austin area.

What are your office hours?

Monday to Wednesday 8:00am to 6:30pm, Thursday 1:00pm to 6:30pm, Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

Do you see kids and expecting moms?

Yes. Family chiropractic is part of what we do, including care for kids and care during pregnancy.

What happens at a first visit?

A thorough exam allows us to see what makes you tick. We take objective measures of structure and function to help us track progress throughout your care. The exam covers a vast array of metrics, so please plan 90-120 minutes for your initial exam.

Do you take insurance? What does care cost?

Insurance and pricing: NEEDS FROM CLIENT. The site notes: You have the right to receive a “Good Faith Estimate” explaining how much your medical care will cost.
